item.title: capture: public-topic write answers and forms (LOT-048 inputs)
item.body:
Closes #264
Closes #128
Claim: mac/cap-public-writes-opus

Not a lot: capture batch for LOT-048 (#74) and LOT-036 (#63), part A of the public-write capture (operator-approved P01, 2026-10-27).

**Problem.** LOT-048 trusted only private-message writes: no public reply/edit/delete answer and no public edit form were captured, so the edit action on public topics was unverified (HFR-PROTOCOL §3.1 step 4).

**What was captured** (one public topic, cat 13, account user2; the reply was deleted two minutes later and is gone, `R61e`):
- `R61b` public reply composer (same fields as `R40a`), `W30` reply answer (refresh to page **1** `#bas`, the post landed on the last page, `R61d`).
- `R62a`/`R62b` public edit form of a later post: action `/bdd.php?config=hfr.inc`, hidden `sujet`, `stickold=0`, "Effacer ce message"; `W31` edit answer (`#t<n>`), `W32` delete answer (refresh without slug or anchor).
- `W33` empty-body refusal (same sentence as `W17a`), nothing posted.

**Changes.** Corpus files + metas (`publish.py`), `corpus.json`, MANIFEST rows (run 4); LOT-004 `form`/`response` oracles for R61b, R62a, R62b, W30–W33 (existing 37 unchanged); HFR-PROTOCOL §3.1 step 4, LOT-036 form rows, §7 E15 (public variant) and X1 (public later-post delete); LOT-036 and LOT-048 pending captures narrowed to the public first-post edit form and the public new-topic answer; checklist P01 marked approved.

**Anonymization.** `check --corpus` 230/230 clean, `check --config` clean, plus an independent check over the raw files (names, tokens, cookies, ids): 0 findings. It first caught the operator id left in `find_smilies_timer('hfr.inc',<id>)` because the local config had no ids; fixed in the config and re-published (900002). Corpus reviewed by Fable: APPROVE.

**Tests.** `HopFormOracleTests` (R61b, R62a, R62b; its map-coverage test fails without them), `HopResponseParserTests` (W30–W33 differential, and the corpus sweep now expects the three public confirmations: it fails without them), `PostingBodyOracleTests` (R61b, R62a: same fields as legacy), `publicRefresh` (exact W30-W32 refresh URLs). `swift test` and the fixture kit tests green.

Part B (public first-post edit form, own topic) follows in a separate PR once the anonymizer can unlink it.
